considered, not kept.reason: The processor control-unit state rule bars control and status registers set by instruction writes, traps or returns, including their read-back contents, as concepts of their own.
Pending interrupt, exception-buffer and trap-cause registers are explicitly processor control-unit state and therefore are not kept as separate concepts.
The state register and its next-state logic only sequence instruction steps, so the sequencing-state rule bars it as information of its own.
The monitor count only paces and detects a prolonged ALU wait, so the pacing-pulse and sequencing rules fold it into the operation it times.
The frontend instruction, valid and compression fields form a transfer record whose word and handshake are not concepts of this forwarding control unit.
Instruction fields that select a CSR operation or access are covered by the operation-selector and access-command-field rules rather than being separate concepts.
Clock, reset and reset-copy behavior are excluded by the clocks-and-resets rule.
The ISA feature generics and implementation generics only fix the build and cannot be changed or withheld at run time.
The processor control-unit state rule bars the control and status register contents that the register read-back word returns, even though csr_rdata_o is an output.
